This directory vendors libsquish from https://github.com/KonajuGames/libsquish

Pinned upstream revision: 7543ea155b475f129d3733b98b7f17f1fa274cf1 (2016-01-21).
The upstream API uses float RGBA pixels; squish_compat.cpp adapts the five-argument byte RGBA ABI expected by Corsix Mod Studio's Rainman library.
